def solve(g):

    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if g[r][c]==2]
    from collections import Counter
    rowcnt=Counter(r for r,c in pts)
    spine=max(rowcnt, key=lambda r:(rowcnt[r],-abs(r-sum(p[0] for p in pts)/len(pts))))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
